versos.grego: Μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία· πιστεύετε εἰς τὸν Θεόν, καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ πιστεύετε.

controles.web: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
controles.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
controles.livre: Não se perturbe vosso coração; credes em Deus, crede também em mim.

versos.grego: ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ Πατρός μου μοναὶ πολλαί εἰσιν· εἰ δὲ μή, εἶπον ἂν ὑμῖν· ὅτι πορεύομαι ἑτοιμάσαι τόπον ὑμῖν·

controles.web: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
controles.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
controles.livre: Na casa de meu Pai há muitas moradas; senão, eu vos diria; vou para vos preparar lugar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῶ καὶ ἑτοιμάσω τόπον ὑμῖν, πάλιν ἔρχομαι καὶ παραλήμψομαι ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἦτε.

controles.web: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
controles.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
controles.livre: E quando eu for, e vos preparar lugar, outra vez virei, e vos tomarei comigo, para que vós também estejais onde eu estiver.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω οἴδατε τὴν ὁδόν.

controles.web: Where I go, you know, and you know the way.”
controles.kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
controles.livre: E já sabeis para onde vou, e sabeis o caminho.

versos.grego: Λέγει αὐτῷ Θωμᾶς Κύριε, οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ὑπάγεις· πῶς οἴδαμεν τὴν ὁδὸν;

controles.web: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
controles.kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Tomé: Senhor, não sabemos para onde vais; e como podemos saber o caminho?

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή· οὐδεὶς ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα εἰ μὴ δι’ ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
controles.livre: Jesus lhe disse: Eu sou o caminho, e a verdade, e a vida. Ninguém vem ao Pai, a não ser por mim.

versos.grego: εἰ ἐγνώκειτέ με, καὶ τὸν Πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε· ἀπ’ ἄρτι γινώσκετε αὐτὸν καὶ ἑωράκατε.

controles.web: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.”
controles.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
controles.livre: Se vós conhecêsseis a mim, também conheceríeis a meu Pai; e desde agora já o conheceis, e o tendes visto.

versos.grego: Λέγει αὐτῷ Φίλιππος Κύριε, δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν Πατέρα, καὶ ἀρκεῖ ἡμῖν.

controles.web: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
controles.kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Filipe: Senhor, mostra-nos ao Pai, e basta-nos.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τοσοῦτον χρόνον μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωκάς με, Φίλιππε; ὁ ἑωρακὼς ἐμὲ ἑώρακεν τὸν Πατέρα· πῶς σὺ λέγεις Δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν Πατέρα;

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
controles.livre: Jesus lhe disse: Tanto tempo há que estou convosco, e ainda não me tens conhecido, Filipe? Quem a mim tem visto, já tem visto ao Pai; e como dizes tu: Mostra-nos ao Pai?

versos.grego: οὐ πιστεύεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί ἐστιν; τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐ λαλῶ· ὁ δὲ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοὶ μένων ποιεῖ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
controles.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
controles.livre: Não crês tu que eu estou no Pai, e que o Pai está em mim? As palavras que eu vos falo, não as falo de mim mesmo, mas o Pai que está em mim, ele é o que faz as obras.

versos.grego: πιστεύετέ μοι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί· εἰ δὲ μή, διὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτὰ πιστεύετε.

controles.web: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
controles.kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
controles.livre: Crede em mim que eu estou no Pai, e que o Pai está em mim; e quando não, crede em mim por causa das próprias obras.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ κἀκεῖνος ποιήσει, καὶ μείζονα τούτων ποιήσει, ὅτι ἐγὼ πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα πορεύομαι·

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
controles.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
controles.livre: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que aquele que crê em mim, as obras que eu faço também ele as fará; e fará maiores que estas. Porque eu vou a meu Pai.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅ τι ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου, τοῦτο ποιήσω, ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ.

controles.web: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
controles.kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
controles.livre: E tudo quanto pedirdes em meu nome, eu o farei; para que o Pai seja glorificado no Filho.

versos.grego: ἐάν τι αἰτήσητέ με ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐγὼ ποιήσω.

controles.web: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
controles.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
controles.livre: Se alguma coisa me pedirdes em meu nome, eu a farei.

versos.grego: Ἐὰν ἀγαπᾶτέ με, τὰς ἐντολὰς τὰς ἐμὰς τηρήσετε.

controles.web: If you love me, keep my commandments.
controles.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
controles.livre: Se me amais, guardai meus mandamentos.

versos.grego: κἀγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ἄλλον Παράκλητον δώσει ὑμῖν ἵνα ᾖ μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα,

controles.web: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,—
controles.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
controles.livre: E eu rogarei ao Pai, e ele vos dará outro Consolador, para que fique sempre convosco;

versos.grego: τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὃ ὁ κόσμος οὐ δύναται λαβεῖν, ὅτι οὐ θεωρεῖ αὐτὸ οὐδὲ γινώσκει· ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε αὐτό, ὅτι παρ’ ὑμῖν μένει καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται.

controles.web: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive; for it doesn’t see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.
controles.kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
controles.livre: Ao Espírito de verdade, a quem o mundo não pode receber; porque não o vê, nem o conhece; mas vós o conheceis, porque habita convosco, e estará em vós.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἀφήσω ὑμᾶς ὀρφανούς, ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
controles.kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
controles.livre: Não vos deixarei órfãos; eu virei a vós.

versos.grego: ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ὁ κόσμος με οὐκέτι θεωρεῖ, ὑμεῖς δὲ θεωρεῖτέ με, ὅτι ἐγὼ ζῶ καὶ ὑμεῖς ζήσετε.

controles.web: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
controles.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
controles.livre: Ainda um pouco, e o mundo não me verá mais; mas vós me vereis; porque eu vivo, e vós vivereis.

versos.grego: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ γνώσεσθε ὑμεῖς ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρί μου καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν.

controles.web: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
controles.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
controles.livre: Naquele dia conhecereis que estou em meu Pai, e vós em mim, e eu em vós.

versos.grego: ὁ ἔχων τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τηρῶν αὐτὰς, ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαπῶν με· ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν με ἀγαπηθήσεται ὑπὸ τοῦ Πατρός μου, κἀγὼ ἀγαπήσω αὐτὸν καὶ ἐμφανίσω αὐτῷ ἐμαυτόν.

controles.web: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
controles.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
controles.livre: Quem tem meus mandamentos, e os guarda, esse é o que me ama; e quem a mim me ama, será amado de meu Pai, e eu o amarei, e a ele me manifestarei.

versos.grego: Λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰούδας, οὐχ ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης Κύριε, καὶ τί γέγονεν ὅτι ἡμῖν μέλλεις ἐμφανίζειν σεαυτὸν καὶ οὐχὶ τῷ κόσμῳ;

controles.web: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
controles.kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Judas (não o Iscariotes): Senhor, que há, porque a nós te manifestarás, e não ao mundo?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ, με τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσει, καὶ ὁ Πατήρ μου ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν, καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐλευσόμεθα καὶ μονὴν παρ’ αὐτῷ ποιησόμεθα.

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: Se alguém me ama, guardará minha palavra, e meu Pai o amará, e viremos a ele, e faremos morada com ele.

versos.grego: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν με τοὺς λόγους μου οὐ τηρεῖ· καὶ ὁ λόγος ὃν ἀκούετε οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸς ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με Πατρός.

controles.web: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
controles.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.
controles.livre: Quem não me ama, não guarda minhas palavras. E a palavra que ouvis não é minha, mas sim do Pai que me enviou.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν παρ’ ὑμῖν μένων·

controles.web: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.
controles.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
controles.livre: Estas coisas tenho dito a vós, estando ainda convosco.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Παράκλητος, τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ὃ πέμψει ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐκεῖνος ὑμᾶς διδάξει πάντα καὶ ὑπομνήσει ὑμᾶς πάντα ἃ εἶπον ὑμῖν ἐγώ.

controles.web: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
controles.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
controles.livre: Mas aquele Consolador, o Espírito Santo, ao qual o Pai enviará em meu nome, esse vos ensinará tudo, e tudo quanto tenho dito vós, ele vos fará lembrar.

versos.grego: Εἰρήνην ἀφίημι ὑμῖν, εἰρήνην τὴν ἐμὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν· οὐ καθὼς ὁ κόσμος δίδωσιν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν. μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία μηδὲ δειλιάτω.

controles.web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
controles.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
controles.livre: A paz vos deixo, minha paz vos dou; vou dá- la a vós, não como o mundo a dá. Não se perturbe vosso coração, nem se atemorize.

versos.grego: ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν Ὑπάγω καὶ ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς. εἰ ἠγαπᾶτέ με, ἐχάρητε ἄν ὅτι πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα, ὅτι ὁ Πατὴρ μείζων μού ἐστιν.

controles.web: You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
controles.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
controles.livre: Já ouvistes que vos tenho dito: Vou, e venho a vós. Se me amásseis, verdadeiramente vos alegraríeis, porque tenho dito: Vou ao Pai; pois meu Pai maior é que eu.

versos.grego: καὶ νῦν εἴρηκα ὑμῖν πρὶν γενέσθαι, ἵνα ὅταν γένηται πιστεύσητε.

controles.web: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.
controles.kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
controles.livre: E já agora o disse a vós antes que aconteça, para que quando acontecer, o creiais.

versos.grego: οὐκέτι πολλὰ λαλήσω μεθ’ ὑμῶν, ἔρχεται γὰρ ὁ τοῦ κόσμου ἄρχων· καὶ ἐν ἐμοὶ οὐκ ἔχει οὐδέν,

controles.web: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
controles.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
controles.livre: Já não falarei muito convosco; pois o príncipe deste mundo já vem, e ele nada tem em mim.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ἵνα γνῷ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι ἀγαπῶ τὸν Πατέρα, καὶ καθὼς ἐνετείλατο μοι ὁ Πατὴρ, οὕτως ποιῶ. Ἐγείρεσθε, ἄγωμεν ἐντεῦθεν.

controles.web: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.
controles.kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
controles.livre: Mas para que o mundo saiba que eu amo ao Pai, e assim faço como o Pai me mandou; levantai-vos, vamos embora daqui.
